title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: the laws between eater phases
text: Over 12,482 phases the next fuel of an eater is built fresh by the hits it passes down (one rung per 11 hits, ratio 44/21, or per 21 hits, ratio 4; small offsets) or is the rest of the same run. The arithmetic of such descents is proved in Lean (lean/Descent.lean). The bound stays at wall visit 108.73·10146. Three fixes let the accelerator run past phase 30 again. (Corrected: this entry first said the word below the eater grows; it does not, the extra runs were one run stored in many pieces.)
